info.title: Oxly Plugin
info.description: Phase 5 discovery doc: Oxly MCP lives at /mcp (Streamable HTTP, protocol 2025-06-18) with 6 project-scoped read-only tools. REST auth stays on JWT; MCP auth uses the project ak_... key per tool call (DEMO_MODE=true allows keyless calls with explicit project_id). Phase 5 adds consistent pagination (total/limit/offset), strict status/severity/interval validation, and true total span_count on get_trace.

post.description: JSON-RPC: initialize, notifications/initialized, tools/list (6 tools), tools/call. Pass api_key (ak_...) on every call; optional project_id must match. List tools return total + limit/offset echo; get_trace caps spans at 200 with spans_truncated flag.

ApiKeyAuth.description: Project scoping: api_key (ak_...) scopes to its project; optional project_id must match or the tool fails with `unknown project`. DEMO_MODE=true allows omitting api_key with an explicit project_id.

api_key.description: Project SDK key (ak_...). Omit only with DEMO_MODE=true + explicit project_id.

project_id.description: Optional; must match the key's project.

Pagination.description: Consistent Phase 5 pagination: total is the full result count; limit/offset are the clamped, echoed inputs.

count.description: Page size (kept on query_security_alerts for compat; equals len(alerts)).

status.description: Case-insensitive; anything else fails with `unknown status`.

severity.description: Case-insensitive; anything else fails with `unknown severity`.

GetTraceArgs.description: Returns full trace with spans in replay order (max 200 spans, spans_truncated flag, span_count is the true total).

start_date.description: Unix seconds; must be <= end_date when both given.

ErrorModel.description: No cross-project oracle: bad key, mismatched project_id, and out-of-scope ids are indistinguishable by design.

unknown_trace.description: id not found OR not in the key's project.

unknown_span.description: id not found OR not in the key's project.

unknown_severity.description: severity must be low | medium | high | critical.

unknown_interval.description: interval must be hour | day | week.
